Enter the full WebDAV endpoint URL provided by your host, then your WebDAV username and password.

Use smb://host/share/folder. Leave the username blank for guest access, or enter user / DOMAIN\\user and your password. The share must be on the same local network as this device. SMB2/3 is required (legacy SMB1 is not supported).

Use nfs://host/export/path, where everything after the host is the exported path. Only NFSv3 (with AUTH_SYS) is supported — NFSv2 and NFSv4 are not. Optionally set a uid:gid that the export grants access to. The export must allow this device\'s IP, offer an NFSv3 mount, and be on the same local network.
